recipes.name: Pretzel Stuffed Dates
instructions: Using a sharp paring knife, make an incision along the length of each date, but try not to cut the date in half.
Remove the pits from the dates.
Break apart the pretzel and place the pieces inside the empty dates.
Dollop the peanut butter over the pretzel.
If desired, drizzle the filled dates with melted chocolate and a sprinkle of sea salt. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store these dates at room temperature in an airtight container for up to 3 days, or in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. Note that if not enjoyed the same day, the pretzels will likely lose their crunch.
